notes.title: 1000 demo downloads and a big reveal
notes.content:
[p][b]WOW.[/b][/p][p]Over [b]1,000 of you downloaded the [i]Neko Neko Love[/i] demo[/b] during Steam Next Fest — and the whole team is purring with joy! 🐾✨[/p][p]This was our very first Next Fest, and we’ve absolutely loved seeing your streams, reading your messages, and hearing your thoughts. [/p][p]Thank you for spending time with our grumpy little cat. We hope you’ve grown fond of them... despite their [i]charming[/i] personality 😉[/p][p]And because we couldn’t let this emotional week end without a little gift…[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Here it is: the big reveal of the cat’s "meow interests"[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595572/654861852fabaa2590ec3e417bc38346f1618b41.png"][/img]You’ve been wondering who lives behind the doors on the main street — now it’s time to meet them.[/p][p]So… who’s hiding in the blue house? The tiny shed? The fancy one?
We’re not saying anything. Not yet, at least. 👀[/p][p][/p][h2][b]What’s next?[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We’re working on a patch to polish the demo based on your feedback, and we’re still joining lovely streamers who want to chat about [i]Neko Neko Love[/i].[/p][p]Follow us on Instagram to catch all the behind-the-scenes fun of our dev journey![/p][p]Thank you, from the bottom of our hearts, for your support and kindness 💖
See you soon for the next chapter![/p][p]— The Belladone Games Team[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Neko Neko Love Demo is Here…
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone! [/p][p][/p][p]Big news from the Belladone Games team — [b]the demo for Neko Neko Love is officially LIVE[/b] and ready for you to play as part of [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]! ✨[/p][p][/p][p]Now, we have to be honest with you… it almost didn’t happen.[/p][p]
[b]Our main cat vanished.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Yup. Just when we were about to wrap things up, that sneaky furball packed his little suitcase and went on vacation. 🍹🌴 No text. No postcard. Just gone.[/p][p][b]The whole team had to drop everything and go full detective mode.[/b] We chased him through alleyways, questioned suspicious creatures, negotiated with a gang of froglins, and even tried luring him back with tuna. It was intense. You can see the pictures. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595572/167c46f5af40758552d99523a777492aeaef40c0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]But we finally got him back and the demo is here![/b][/p][p][/p][h2][b]What’s in the demo?[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]🐱 [b]A glimpse into the Cat’s daily life[/b] on this new continent — and his main challenge: [b]how to get dinner tonight.[/b][/p][p]🐉 [b]A brand-new character: the Drake Lantern,[/b] the Cat’s long-time rival with a fiery temper and some serious style.[/p][p]🎥 [b]An exclusive, emotional cutscene[/b] inspired by traditional Japanese ukiyo-e art. (Tears may happen. Don’t say we didn’t warn you.)[/p][p]🎶 [b]A captivating lofi fantasy soundtrack[/b] to vibe with as you navigate feline chaos.[/p][p][/p][p][b]So… how are [i]you[/i] going to solve the Cat’s problem?[/b][/p][p][/p][p] [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3794040/Neko_Neko_Love_Demo/" style="button"]Play the Demo Now on Steam![/url][/p][p][/p][p]And don’t forget to wishlist the game if you haven’t already. The cat might escape again, and you’ll definitely want to be in the loop when it happens.[/p][p]Thanks for your support, and for helping us wrangle this four-pawed menace back into the game.[/p][p]
— The very happy Belladone Games Team[/p]
